author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace policy. The 'pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>' pattern is mandated by the workspace extras-preservation policy at AGENTS.md and is identical across every extension-client params struct. serde_json::Map type-exposure is a workspace-wide policy property. Changing only metadata-client diverges from policy. Either workspace accepts the coupling (most likely — serde_json hasn't broken its API in years) or the policy itself changes.
